grid.note: A=image-left=+azimuth(CCW,left of forward). Cell az = camera-frame horizontal azimuth atan2(y_c,x_c). Sectors are BYTE-IDENTICAL to gridspec_v0.json -- V1 changes the range bands only.
grid.nesting_note: V1 is a strict REFINEMENT of V0: bands 1 and 2 are unchanged (cells 0-9 keep their V0 index and meaning), and V0's band 3 [5,12) m is split exactly at 8 m into 3a [5,8) and 3b [8,12). Hence V0_cell(10+s) == V1_cell(10+s) OR V1_cell(15+s), the outer radius (12 m) and the angular coverage are unchanged, so the set of ground points inside the grid is identical and every frame-level property that depends only on grid COVERAGE (any-cell-positive, therefore the none_in_fov tier, and the lip seed mask cell>=0, therefore edge_ratio) is invariant between V0 and V1.
grid.rollback: swap this file for gridspec_v0.json and re-run labeler.py + build_manifest.py; nothing else is parameterised on the grid.
